summary: Feed c100_crc is degraded: VF-1 port 1 (input) shows 18,480 CRC/alignment errors (0.3495% vs 0.001% threshold) indicating physical layer fault. APM will receive corrupted/incomplete traffic.

findings.root_cause: Physical layer fault on VF-1 port 1 (input) - 18,480 damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors (0.3495% error rate) caused by faulty cable, optic, or duplex/speed mismatch on the link into the packet broker
findings.impact_on_tool: APM receives damaged frames that are dropped or fail parsing, causing incomplete flows/transactions, inaccurate response-time and error metrics, and reduced visibility/coverage

recommended_fix.why: Reseat/replace cable and optic, clean fiber, verify duplex/speed settings on VF-1 port 1 to eliminate CRC errors before delivery to APM
